articles.title: The Fat That Fights Cancer? Not the One You'd Guess!
articles.summary: Scientists found that olive oil's main fat made pancreatic cancer grow faster in mice. But fish oil fats slowed it way down. The type of fat matters more than how much you eat.

articles.title: Seeing with Sound: How Some Blind People 'Click' to Navigate
articles.summary: Expert blind echolocators use tongue clicks to build mental maps of rooms. A new brain study shows they combine echoes over time, getting sharper pictures with each click.

articles.title: Alien Winds at 15,000 MPH! First Proof of Magnetic Fields on Distant Worlds
articles.summary: Astronomers found magnetic fields on seven hot Jupiter exoplanets by measuring their insane winds—up to 15,530 mph. These fields could protect planets, maybe even help life survive.
